protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: CVE-2026-9318 is PUBLISHED on CVE.org (not rejected/withdrawn; GHSA withdrawn_at is null). HTMLFormat.export_book interpolates Dataset.title into an <h3> (BOOK_ENDINGS) without escaping. Attacker-controlled titles arrive from the API or imported sheet names (xlsx dset.title = sheet.title, xls dset.title = sheet.name, ods dset.title = sheet name, yaml data.title = sheet['title']) and are written as raw HTML. At v3.9.0 the sink is result += f'<{cls.BOOK_ENDINGS}>{title}</{cls.BOOK_ENDINGS}>\n'. Execution requires a consumer to render the export in a browser. Direct fix b0ff39fb9b2f457e5332249b4cc2ec11eabf46ee (PR 668) uses ET.Element + ET.tostring(..., method='html') and test_html_databook_export_escaped expects <script> titles to become <script>.
